headline: Anthropic grants outside AI safety evaluator employee-like access
summary: Anthropic has given an outside AI safety evaluator, identified as METR, access comparable to an employee's, and the evaluator can publish its assessments without Anthropic's approval.

claims.statement: Anthropic granted an outside AI evaluator access comparable to that of an employee.
The evaluator can publish its findings about Anthropic without the company's approval.

sources.quote: the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them
can publish its findings without Anthropic's approval

claims.statement: The outside evaluator granted this access is identified as METR.
